sentences.text:
Baby Sannidhi, Through Natural ... vs Gaurav Batra on 5 August,
2025
Author: Amit Sharma

Bench: Amit Sharma  $~101  * IN THE HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI  + CONT.CAS(C) 1177/2025  BABY SANNIDHI, THROUGH NATURAL GUARDIAN, MS.
 ANU SALUJA .....

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petiti
Through: MR. Vihaan Kumar, Mr. Vikas  Kumar, Advs. along with Ms. Anu  Saluja, Mother/guardian of the  petitioner (through VC).
versus  GAURAV BATRA  .....

Respondent  Through: Mr. Rajiv Agarwal, Ms. Meghna D  and Ms. L. Gangmei, Advs.
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  ORDER % 05.08.2025 1.
This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.
CM APPL. 47675/2025(exemption)
2. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
This application is disposed of.

The present petition under Section 2(B) read with Section 10 and 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 seeks the following prayers: -
"(a) Initiate contempt proceedings under the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971 against the Respondent / Alleged contemnor for wilfully and deliberately disobeying the judgment / order dated 13.12.2017 passed by the Ld. Family Courts, Tis Hazari Courts, West District, Delhi in MT No. 240 / 2014 titled as "Baby Sannidhi vs. Gaurav Batra".

(b) Punish the Respondent/Contemnor for the wilful disobedience of the judgment / order dated 13.12.2017 passed by the Ld. Family Courts, Tis Hazari Courts, West District, Delhi in MT No. 240 /
2014 titled as "Baby Sannidhi vs. Gaurav Batra".
(c) Pass any other or further order/orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case This is a digitally signed order.

1

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 08/08/2025 at 22:58:13 and in the interests of justice."
4.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner submits that the matter was settled with the respondent in pursuance of the settlement recorded vide order/judgment dated 13.12.2017 by the then Principal Judge, Family Courts (West), Tis Hazari Courts, New Delhi, it was agreed between the parties that the respondent will pay a sum of Rs. 15,00,000/- to the petitioner.

entities.text: Principal Judge, Family Courts (West), Tis Hazari Courts, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
It was further agreed that the said amount will be paid in 3 installments i.e. Rs. 5,00,000/- at the time of the first motion, Rs. 5,00,000/- at the time of the second motion and the remaining amount of Rs.
5,00,000/- at the time of the quashing of the FIR bearing no. 0184/2016 under Sections 406/498A/34 of the IPC registered at PS Kirti Nagar.
5.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner draws the attention of this Court to an order dated 22.08.2024, whereby the Coordinate Bench of this Court in CRL.M.C. 3753/2022 dismissed the petition filed by the respondent for quashing of FIR on the ground of non-payment of the last instalment of Rs. 5,00,000/-.

6. Issue notice to the respondent on petitioner taking necessary steps through all permissible modes including electronic mail, if any, returnable on 11.11.2025.
7.
Notice may be served through the counsel who is appearing on behalf of the respondent in the Family Courts.
AMIT SHARMA, J AUGUST 5, 2025/
